name: engram
description: Engram 仿人脑分层长期记忆的 Codex 适配器：会话开始注入记忆热索引、会话结束自动复盘巩固，并提供 engram skill 让 agent 在该检索时主动回溯记忆。单 Rust 二进制、零外部依赖。

interface.shortDescription: Human-like layered long-term memory for Codex
interface.longDescription: Engram injects a memory hot-index at session start and runs an independent reviewer at session end to consolidate what mattered (promote/demote, supersede, merge). An engram skill teaches the agent recall-first: when asked what a project is, what's left to do, or whether something was handled before, it recalls from memory before scanning code. Portable Rust engine + redb store, no external services.
defaultPrompt: What does this project do and what's left to finish? Check engram memory first.
Have we dealt with this before? Recall from engram before scanning the code.
